'''Lindy''' was an old friend of [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] who assisted Klivian and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] in defecting to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Lindy became friends with [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]]. Lindy had contacts in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and let Klivian, a Rebel sympathizer, know. On graduating from [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt IV naval academy]], Klivian decided to defect to the Rebel Alliance, taking with him [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']], the ship on which he served. To that end, he contacted Lindy on [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. Lindy was able to put him in contact with Alliance agents and facilitated the ''Rand Ecliptic''{{'s}} escape, under the control of Klivian and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], to the Rebel Alliance.
